checks: All seven folder empty states plus Home, search and Contacts render their distinct guidance/actions
Ordinary Back/reload warns for unsaved text; cancel retains it, and saved draft survives actual Back and reload
Encrypted key lock hides text without discarding it; close and reload cannot silently lose unsaved work; unlock/save/reload restores ciphertext draft
Lost committed phone-change response recovers the identical request/idempotency key using pre-change cookies; immutable identity retained
Profile, alias and preference transport failures stay next to the affected section; edits remain, failed toggle rolls back and retry succeeds
Contact backend validation error preserves input and is associated with address field
151-contact fixture uses bounded 50-row pages and server search beyond the first 100; short paging/heap sample recorded
limitations: Disposable isolated local backend and development frontend. Fault routes abort actual requests/responses; successful operations are not mocked. Unsaved-memory navigation checks cancel the browser warning; leaving despite the warning can discard unsaved work. Key lock invokes the actual service while compose owns focus. Contact paging is a short unthrottled sample with other acceptance running, not a soak.
